issues.description: The problem statement (and UML) requires the Lecture constructor parameters to follow the attribute order: (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution implementation provides a constructor with a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch between the specification and the solution reference can confuse students when they look at the solution or tests that expect the UML order, and it contradicts the explicit instruction to follow the UML parameter order.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the constructor in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java (solution) to follow the UML/order from the problem: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and update the parameter assignments accordingly (this.numberOfInscribedStudents = numberOfInscribedStudents; etc.). Alternatively, if the different order was intentional, update the problem statement/UML to reflect the actual constructor signature to avoid confusion.
